title: Remove App/Event dropdown from Single Comment Generator in User View

requirements.text: In the Single Comment Generator section within the User View tab (frontend/src/views/UserView.tsx), remove the App/Event dropdown selector entirely. The user should go directly to the 'Select Comment List' dropdown without first choosing an app/event. Since the Comment List dropdown was previously filtered by the selected app/event, it must now show all unlocked comment lists from all apps/events. All other functionality (available count display, device lock notice, Generate Single Comment button, copy output, out-of-comments badge) must remain unchanged. Do not remove or modify App/Event selectors in any other tab or section.

quotes: Just remove select app/Event from single comment generator only

acceptanceCriteria: The Single Comment Generator card in the User View tab does not contain an App/Event dropdown.
The 'Select Comment List' dropdown in the Single Comment Generator shows all unlocked comment lists regardless of app/event.
The Available Comments count, device lock notice, Generate Single Comment button, copy output, and out-of-comments badge all continue to function correctly.
App/Event selectors in other tabs (Live Checker, Upload/Bulk Comment Generator, etc.) are unaffected.
No console errors related to undefined selectedApp or app-event filtering in the Single Comment Generator.

constraints: Only modify the Single Comment Generator section in frontend/src/views/UserView.tsx.
Do not remove or alter App/Event selectors in any other component or tab.
Do not change any backend logic.
nonGoals: Removing App/Event selectors from Live Checker, Upload tab, or Admin views.
Redesigning the Single Comment Generator card layout beyond removing the dropdown.
